description: Central Province - Rules for paying allowances for members of Pradeshiya Sabhas and Regulations for paying Special Allowances for Mayors, Deputy Mayors and members of Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Matale Municipal Councils
categorisation: This gazette content concerns public service administration matters, specifically the establishment of rules and regulations for paying various allowances (fuel, telephone, and meeting attendance) to members of local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas and Municipal Councils) under the Central Provincial Council. It deals with service conditions and benefits for public officials at the local government level, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of enacting administrative regulations rather than personnel appointments or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
